abstract: These days, the number of ABAC students has almost doubled since 2010, and more and more work and responsibilities have to be taken from the University. Among them, one of the main responsibilities is to handle the students' grades, including for each subject grading system, and generating them. On top of that, there are so many subjects that share the subject code which make it more complicated and difficult to generate all the grade reports manually. It is tough to make changes, check or modify for each subject one by one. Besides, the possibility of human errors is very common in this case. Thus, we plan to make the "Grade Report Generator" which will solve all the struggling secretaries are facing right now. "Grade Report Generator" is a web application that automatically generates the grade report of the subjects offered by VMS faculty in a semester. Some of the main features of our project are such as managing semester and approval committees, managing codeshare subjects and subjects offered in a semester, managing grading criteria of each subject and its codeshare subjects and also to generate minutes of meeting, change the date or move the meeting place and so on. In this report, we are going to provide what is the scope of our project, how we create the Grade Report Generator including the methodology, workflow and so on.

canonical_title: Estimation of Possible Shoplifting from Video Frames
advisor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Dobri Atanassov Batovski
committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Anilkumar Kothalil Gopalakrishnan
abstract: Both individuals and companies suffer significant financial and time losses as a result of crime. Surveillance cameras create so much data that it's difficult for them to analyze it all in real time. Although the human eye has its limitations, one of the significant considerations in surveillance is visual concentration. A crime may take place in another section of the screen or on a separate monitor and the staff may fail to catch it. Due to the advancements in computer vision and machine learning technology, there are a variety of applications that can be implemented to solve many customers' pain points. Shop owners, for example, are subjected to theft because the most effective method of preventing it necessitates extensive manual labor in reviewing CCTV feeds, and most of the time the act has already occurred. The goal of this project is to eliminate the need for human intervention by using real-time computer vision to detect shoplifting and to provide immediate feedback or alerts. It was decided to develop a deep learning model that would be able to detect items in the shop and identify malicious activity. Aside from that, the model was implemented into a Raspberry Pi unit, which was used to perform real-time computation. By ensuring proper installation of the device, shoplifting can be detected accurately and quickly in real time.

abstract: In universities in Thailand, an examination is the main point to measure what students understand in the courses. Instructors have the opportunity to monitor and evaluate their teaching strategies according to their students' progress. The examination has multiple-choice questions and written questions. The examination standard is separated to the quiz, mid-term, and final examinations. Next, the students can improve their knowledge and skills. They can learn more. All knowledge in each course is helpful to adapt to use after graduation. XAM is an examination system application for Assumption University built on two platforms. First, it is an iOS that focuses on the use case of students who must take the examination and submit it. Proctors can scan and check the students in the examination room. Another is a web application platform for managing the system on the users and courses for the admin staff. In the last role, Instructors can create, edit, remove the examination for their courses. They can also check the class members and the students' submissions in each examination.

abstract:
Letmeet is a system that help the user reserve the meeting room. It facilitates the user to search and reserve a meeting room. The user could register to the system, they can access and modify their account by singing in.

The user account could maintain the participant and manager detail, with their reservation and meeting information. Moreover, they can view their meeting invitation and meeting history in their own user menu. Team function also provided in this system.

The manager can make a reservation and invite participant to the meeting. Manager is one who can create a team for meeting and add member to the team. So, participant could be added to the team by manager. Also, they can cancel reservation, update and delete team.

The system admin can add meeting room to the system. They can verify the user account when the user register to the system. System Admin can also view meeting room summary and reports graph to help them take decision.
